title: Psychic
html:
For other possible meanings of Psychic in the game, see:  Psychic (disambiguation)

⁠Psychic is one of the damage types in the game.

  • For all sources of Psychic, see Category:Sources of Psychic damage.
  • For creatures weak to Psychic, see Category:Vulnerable to Psychic.
  • For creatures resistant to Psychic, see Category:Resistant to Psychic.
  • For creatures immune to Psychic, see Category:Immune to Psychic.

Sources of Psychic damage

The following sections list various ways in which a player character, or creatures they summon, can deal Psychic damage.

Special actions, spells, etc. that are exclusively accessible to non-player characters are not listed.

Spells

  •  Dirty Trick: Vicious Mockery
  •  Dissonant Whispers
  •  Phantasmal Killer
  •  Shadow Blade
  •  Share Untenable Secret
  •  Staggering Smite
  •  Vicious Mockery
  •  Wrathful Smite

Class actions

  •  Arcane Shot: Beguiling Arrow
  •  Arcane Shot: Shadow Arrow
  •  Flurry of Moths: Attack
  •  Shadow Strike
  •  Shadow Strike: Unarmed
  •  Sobering Realisation

Class features

  •  Manifestation of Mind: Unarmed attacks deal + 1d4 + Wisdom Modifier⁠⁠Psychic.

Special actions

  •  Concentrated Blast
  •  Crowning Strike
  •  Devour Intellect

  •  Mind Tax

  •  Synaptic Discharge (Us)
  •  Tentacle Whip (Full-illithid)

Weapons

The following weapons deal Psychic damage as part of their regular attacks.

  •  Blade of Oppressed Souls
  •  Ketheric's Warhammer
  •  Mind Sundering Dagger - inaccessible
  •  Shadow Blade (weapon)
  •  Sword of Screams
  •  Voss' Silver Sword

Equipment

The following equipment add Psychic damage to the wearer's attacks or can deal Psychic damage through other means.

  •  Bonespike Helmet: Upon  Rage, inflict 2d4⁠⁠Psychic to nearby enemies.  WIS Save (Weapon action DC) to halve damage.
  •  Boots of Psionic Movement: A githyanki wearer who casts  Fly gains +1d4⁠⁠Psychic on their next weapon attack.
  •  Circlet of Psionic Revenge: When succeeding a saving throw, deal 1d4⁠⁠Psychic to the attacker.
  •  Githyanki Greatsword (Psionic): A githyanki wielder deals an additional 1d4⁠⁠Psychic with this weapon.
  •  Silver Sword of the Astral Plane: A githyanki wielder deals an additional 1d6⁠⁠Psychic with this weapon.
  •  Slinging Shoes: This item deals +2d4⁠⁠Psychic when thrown.
  •  Soulbreaker Greatsword: A githyanki wielder deals an additional 1d4⁠⁠Psychic with this weapon.
  •  Strange Conduit Ring: When concentrating, weapon attacks deal +1d4⁠⁠Psychic.

Interactions

  •  Braindrain Gloves: Inflict  Mental Fatigue upon dealing psychic damage.
  •  Psionic Ward Armour: A githyanki wearer gains resistance to psychic.
  •  Resonance Stone: The wielder and those around gain the  Steeped in Bliss condition, making them vulnerable to ⁠Psychic damage.
